name: Phantom: Forbidden Bastion
desc: Within the Censure Court lies an Autopuppet hailed as the Censure Court's Apparatus." Legends tell it bears an enormous form and is especially formidable in strength.
desc_open:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

When enemies nearby obtain a shield, Forbidden Bastion takes 10% more total DMG for 6s. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s, stacking up to 4 times.

Every brick and tile in the Censure Court is made of modular parts. It is both an elegant garden and a prison for holding and purging Tacet Discords.
Within the Censure Court, the Forbidden Bastion is one of the most formidable Autopuppets. The columns and ridges within the Court form its towering build.
The ultimate defense that safeguards the grounds, Forbidden Bastion spends year after year purging the Tacet Discords left behind within these walls, maintaining peace within Xuanfang.
